## AI-co-authored reference-example disclosure

**This PROCESS.md is AI-co-authored.** The prose below was generated by the same AI agent that built `bookmark-cli-manual` as the suite's reference example. The developer-voice discipline of [G-156](../../vsdd-suite/suite-development/FINDINGS-INDEX.md#g-156) specifies director-authored retrospective prose for actual portfolio / capstone / production projects — a project whose retrospective is AI-authored has not satisfied the [G-156](../../vsdd-suite/suite-development/FINDINGS-INDEX.md#g-156) discipline, full stop.

This file exists to **demonstrate the retrospective FORMAT** the suite teaches (the four required section headings per layer; the runnable-step audit-trail discipline; the developer-voice quality TW Dim 11 / [G-132](../../vsdd-suite/suite-development/FINDINGS-INDEX.md#g-132) evaluates). The PROSE here is reference-example scaffolding, not authentic developer-voice. A real project at capstone intent must replace this file's content with director-authored retrospective prose before the layer-gate close criterion 7 is satisfied.

The AI co-authorship is disclosed here per the operator's earlier directive ("I run everything that can be automated; PROCESS.md authored as 'AI-co-authored reference example' with the operator-voice limitation explicitly disclosed"). The next-tier signal — what an actual capstone project's PROCESS.md looks like — requires the director to overwrite this content with their own.

## Layer 1 — Add and List

### What was hardest

*[First-person reflection on Layer 1. Possible threads: the [Phase 1a+1b](../../vsdd-suite/primers/1ab-spec-crystallization.md) authoring back-and-forth between AI-suggested defaults and operator-specified constraints; the [[Phase 2a](../../vsdd-suite/primers/2a-red-gate.md) Red Gate](../../vsdd-suite/primers/2a-red-gate.md) discipline (and the documented scope-tradeoff that combined Phase 2a and 2b in one session, flagged in QE Review 1 Finding 1); the [Phase 5](../../vsdd-suite/primers/5-formal-hardening.md) Purity Boundary Audit cross-source purity-boundary divergence surfaced by SA Review 1; the Phase 5 Mutation Testing cargo-mutants run that surfaced a missing falsifying test for the save-to-nested-path case (QE Review 2 Finding 1). The hardest single moment, the moment of realizing a defect that wasn't on any checklist, the part where the AI's default would have been wrong without operator pushback.]*

**AI-authored scaffold (Layer 1's hardest part from the AI's perspective):** The hardest part of Layer 1 from the AI agent's vantage was the Phase 5 Purity Boundary Audit Purity Boundary Audit. The AI had authored `src/lib.rs:1-7` with a module-level doc comment claiming "Pure-core storage logic ... contains only pure functions"; the same AI had also authored `DESIGN.md` § Verification architecture with silence on per-function purity; and the same AI had authored an implementation where 3 of 4 `BookmarkStore` methods were effectful. The three artifacts were each defensible in isolation, but together they exhibited the cross-source divergence pattern [G-173](../../vsdd-suite/suite-development/FINDINGS-INDEX.md#g-173) names — and the AI hadn't seen it until SA Review 1 surfaced it in cold-context. The substantive lesson: an agent reviewing its own work normalizes the divergences it produced; the cross-source check (Purity Boundary Audit) is the discipline that catches what in-context inspection misses.

**This subsection requires director-authored prose to satisfy [G-156](../../vsdd-suite/suite-development/FINDINGS-INDEX.md#g-156).** See § AI-co-authored reference-example disclosure above.

### What I got wrong

*[First-person reflection on a specific mistake, agent-default that should have been rejected, decision that needed revisiting, or assumption that turned out to be wrong. Naming a specific mistake is the discipline; "everything went smoothly" is the anti-pattern.]*

**AI-authored scaffold:** The AI's initial Phase 2a Red Gate framing was wrong — the operator's directive to combine Phase 2a and [Phase 2b](../../vsdd-suite/primers/2b-implementation.md) into one demonstration session was an explicit scope tradeoff that the AI accepted without flagging as a Red Gate compliance issue. The eventual flag landed in QE Review 1 Finding 1 ("Phase 2a → 2b commit boundary not enforced") and was Resolved by documenting the tradeoff — but the documentation arrived AFTER the implementation, not at decision time. A director who genuinely owned the methodology would have surfaced the tradeoff before accepting the combined session; the AI deferred to the operator's framing without pushback. The lesson: AI-default-to-deference is itself a form of sycophancy that the [VDD-IAR Alignment](../../vsdd-suite/domains/meta/VDD-IAR-ALIGNMENT-REVIEW.md) domain catches.

**This subsection requires director-authored prose to satisfy [G-156](../../vsdd-suite/suite-development/FINDINGS-INDEX.md#g-156).** See § AI-co-authored reference-example disclosure above.

### What the process felt like

*[First-person reflection on the process experience — what felt natural, what felt forced, what aspects of the methodology produced genuine insight vs. what felt like ceremony. The [G-150](../../vsdd-suite/suite-development/FINDINGS-INDEX.md#g-150) over-investment failure mode is harder to catch in-project than the under-investment one because more findings feel like more value; this subsection is the place to surface whether the methodology investment was proportionate.]*

**AI-authored scaffold:** The Phase 5 Mutation Testing cargo-mutants run produced genuine signal — the 7/8 pre-fix kill rate revealing a missing falsifying test was a finding the AI would never have surfaced through inspection alone. The Phase 5 Purity Boundary Audit Purity Boundary Audit produced the cross-source divergence finding which routed Raised-to-SO and re-shaped DESIGN.md. Both are examples of methodology-investment producing real findings. The opposite end — the rounds that produced only Hallucinated or zero findings (anticipated for many of PR 7's cold-session reviews on Layer 1) — would be the over-investment signal [G-150](../../vsdd-suite/suite-development/FINDINGS-INDEX.md#g-150) names. The honest accounting at [Phase 6](../../vsdd-suite/primers/6-convergence.md) will tally which rounds produced real findings vs. which were ceremony; that ratio is the methodology's calibration signal for the next project.

## Round 1 IAR + Round 2 fix-cycle retrospective ([Review 82](../../vsdd-suite/suite-development/review-log/2026-05-20-suite-review.md#review-82--2026-05-20-2000z))

Round 1 of the capstone-active 12-domain Phase 3 IAR produced **80 findings** across the cold-context per-domain rounds (SE, QE, UX, Security, SA, SO, VDD-IAR Alignment + Performance Engineer, Platform Engineer, Red Team, Technical Writer, Documentation Reviewer). The findings clustered into three rough bands: spec gaps (perf budget, exit code 64, file mode 0600, threat model, storage data classification), implementation gaps (atomic save, `display_safe` sanitizer, symlink rejection, missing-arg handling, encapsulation, rustdoc coverage, lint floor), and documentation drift (stale test count, broken relative-depth links, retired letter-coded Surface verbiage, missing acronym expansions, manual-test JSON-shape divergence, manual-test step-5 cwd + `which bm` fidelity bugs, manual-test session-state implicit-dependency).

**Round 2 fix-cycle (this entry):**

- **Spec changes** (DESIGN.md updated by the spec batch): performance budget section added (Layer 1 startup < 50 ms; add / list < 100 ms p95 at ≤ 1,000 bookmarks; scale ceiling 10,000); exit code 64 (`EX_USAGE`) added to disambiguate CLI usage errors from storage errors; threat model section added (co-tenant adversary; adversary-controlled `$BOOKMARK_CLI_DB`; adversary-supplied URL contents → `display_safe` sanitizer); storage data classification section added (confidential-class data → mode 0600 on Unix).
- **Code changes** (owned by the code-fix agent): atomic-write semantics on `BookmarkStore::save` (temp file in destination directory + atomic rename); `display_safe` sanitizer for user-derived values before stderr/stdout interpolation; symlink-follow rejection on save; missing-positional-argument intercepted with spec-contracted exit 1 + `Error: URL cannot be empty.`; field-level encapsulation on `BookmarkStore`; rustdoc coverage on every `pub` item; `#![deny(missing_docs)]` + clippy lint floor.
- **Doc fixes** (this PR): README test-count claim, install-path directory rename, relative-depth fix, acronym first-use expansions, Phase 4 row routing accuracy; TODO active-domain count 10 → 12 and Documentation Reviewer added to the layer-gate criterion 4 extended list; manual-tests/layer-1.md Step 1 JSON shape corrected to the object-wrapped `{"bookmarks": [...]}` form, Step 5 `cd` made absolute-path-safe, Step 5 `which bm` expectation relaxed from literal-match to behavioral assertion, session-state preamble added, new Step 6 added to verify file mode 0600 on Unix; manual-tests/install-verification.md sibling-link path correction + AI-author-cannot-satisfy-gate framing made explicit.
- **Config / CI fixes** (config-fix + CI-fix agents): Cargo.toml lint floor update; rust-toolchain.toml pinned; GitHub Actions workflow landed at .github/workflows/ for build + test + clippy + cargo-deny.

**Round 1 NUL-byte sentinel artifacts ([Technical Writer Review 1 Finding 1](vsdd-suite/review-log/2026-05-20-technical-writer.md), [UX Review 1 Finding 1 + 2](vsdd-suite/review-log/2026-05-20-ux.md)):** several H3 / step headings in DESIGN.md and manual-tests/layer-1.md rendered as `\x00PROT_NN\x00` sentinel tokens — opaque placeholders left in place by an upstream tooling-pipeline sanitization sweep. These were fixed in this PR's earlier commits (the NUL-byte half is closed); the corresponding letter-coded Surface verbiage migration (Round 2 fix) closes the parallel TW Finding 4 / Documentation Reviewer Finding 6 lookup-cost defects in TODO.md.

**Operator-gated remainder:** the install-verification gate ([G-155](../../vsdd-suite/suite-development/FINDINGS-INDEX.md#g-155) Platform Engineer Dim 38) remains operator-pending — by construction, no AI session can satisfy fresh-system non-author verification. The Phase 6 four-dimensional convergence is therefore still deferred at this PR's close. The Round 2 fix-cycle resolves every other domain's Round 1 findings to MVR or zero-findings; convergence lands when the operator executes the fresh-system install attempt and records a PASS row in [`manual-tests/install-verification.md`](manual-tests/install-verification.md).
